description.narrative: Brief DescriptionThe Joint Programme applies a nuanced, area-based, and conflict-sensitive approach, ensuring that community participation is optimized. This includes targeted efforts for the inclusion of conflict-affected and marginalized groups, such as women, youth, people with disabilities and the elderly.UNJP 2.0 is a collaborative initiative that brings together the combined expertise and capacities of six UN agencies: FAO, UNDP, UNFPA, UN-Habitat, UNICEF, and WFP. The programme aims to achieve the following overarching objectives:• Improving equitable access to essential services such as electricity, water, education, and healthcare.• Restoring sustainable livelihoods and food systems, fostering long-term resilience and economic stability.• Enhancing social protection, building trust, and improving governance to create a robust and inclusive foundation for community development.UNDP will contribute to the UNPJ through the rehabilitation of electricity network, provision of solar energy, debris management, support of HLP and revive of the livelihoods.

title.narrative: UN Joint Programme to Strengthen Urban and Rural Resilience and the Conditions for Recovery in Syria (UNJP 2.0)

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
